Method of Attack: Impersonation of a legitimate software development kit (SDK) for SentinelOne, containing malicious code to harvest sensitive information from development systems including credentials, configuration data, and SSH keys.
Impacted Systems: Development systems using the malicious SentinelOne package from PyPI
Attack Vector: Impersonation of a legitimate SentinelOne SDK python client, adding malicious functionality to its code.
